name: postgres-search
description: Algolia-style search in plain Postgres, with an optional Jev step that sinks wrong results.

scripts.db: docker run -d --name postgres-search -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres -e POSTGRES_DB=search_demo -p 127.0.0.1:5432:5432 postgres:16
scripts.check-skill-sql: cmp sql/schema.sql skills/postgres-search/sql/schema.sql && cmp sql/functions.sql skills/postgres-search/sql/functions.sql
